content: कण्टकः, -कम् .²1 A thorn; पादलग्नं करस्थेन कण्टकेनैव कण्टकं (उद्धरेत्) <ls>Chāṇ. 22</ls>; कण्टकेनैव कण्टकम् (उन्मूलयेत्) <ls>Pt. 4. 18</ls> .²2 A prickle, a sting; यः कण्टकैर्वितुदति <ls>Y. 3. 53</ls>. .²3 The point of anything. .²4 (<ab>Fig.</ab>) Any troublesome fellow who is, as it were, a thorn to the state and an enemy of order and good government; उत्खातलोकत्रयकण्टकेऽपि <ls>R. 14. 73</ls>; त्रिदिवमुद्धृतदानवकण्टकम् <ls>Ś. 7. 3</ls>; <ls>Ms. 9. 260</ls>; <ls>Mv. 7. 8</ls>. .²5 (Hence) Any source of vexation or annoyance, nuisance; कण्टकानां च शोधनात् <ls>Ms. 9. 253</ls>. .²6 Horripilation, erection of hair, thrill. .²7 A fingernail. .²8 A vexing speech. .²9 A fish-bone; अन्धो मत्स्यानिवाश्नाति स नरः कण्टकैः सह <ls>Ms. 8. 95</ls>. .²10 A sharp stinging pain, symptom of a disease. .²11 (In Nyāya philosophy) Refutation of arguments, detection of error. .²12 Impediment, obstacle. .²13 The first, fourth, seventh, and tenth lunar mansions. .²14 A vexing or injurious speech; <ls>Mb. 1</ls>. .{@-कः@} A bamboo; some other tree (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>बेल, बाभळ, हिंगणबेट</ns>) फलकं परिधानश्च तथा कण्टकवस्त्रधृक् <ls>Mb. 12. 303. 14</ls>; see कण्टकद्रुम. .²2 A work-shop, manufactory. .²3 Fault, defect; निर्धूतवाक्यकण्टकाम् <ls>Mb. 12. 167. 50</ls>. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Makara or the marine monster, the symbol of the god of love. .{@-की@} A kind of वार्ताकी. .{@-फलः@} See कण्टकफल.
